operations.description:
Historical OHLC data for the specified period and interval size

The combination of the interval parameter and start and end dates can result in results
being truncated to conform to result size limits. See comments on interval parameter for details on valid interval values.
operations.summary: Get historical prices for requested currency pairs
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies history [PATH] currencies history [PARAMS] end format interval pairs start [SCHEMA] collection interval response

operations.description:
Only the currency pairs in the direction noted can be used with the history endpoint.
For example: USD/CAD is not the same as CAD/USD
operations.summary: Get list of currency pairs supported by the history endpoint
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies supported currencies history [PATH] currencies history supported [PARAMS] format [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get latest mid rate for requested currency pairs
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies rate [PATH] currencies rate [PARAMS] format pairs [SCHEMA] rate response

operations.description:
Any of the currencies in this list can be paired with any other currency in this list when supplied to the Rate endpoint.
For example: USD/CAD,CAD/USD,USD/EUR,EUR/CAD
operations.summary: Get list of currencies supported by the rate endpoint
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies supported currencies rate [PATH] currencies rate supported [PARAMS] format [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Current and daily summary information combined into a single quote
operations.summary: Get latest Summary for requested currency pairs
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies summary [PATH] currencies summary [PARAMS] format pairs [SCHEMA] response summary

operations.description:

For example: USD/CAD is not the same as CAD/USD
operations.summary: Get list of currency pairs supported by the Summary endpoint
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] currencies supported currencies summary [PATH] currencies summary supported [PARAMS] format [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Historical OHLC data for the specified period and interval size

The combination of the interval parameter and start and end dates can result in results
being truncated to conform to result size limits. See comments on interval parameter for details on valid interval values.

The historicalfx flag is used to determine whether to apply today's fx rates to a historical period, or to apply the historical rates from that same time frame.
operations.summary: Get historical benchmark prices for requested metals
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] metals benchmark history [PATH] metals benchmark history [PARAMS] currency end format historicalfx interval metals start unitofmeasure [SCHEMA] collection interval response

operations.summary: Get latest Benchmark prices for requested metals
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] metals benchmark summary [PATH] metals benchmark summary [PARAMS] currency format metals unitofmeasure [SCHEMA] response summary

operations.summary: Get list of symbols supported by the benchmark endpoints
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] metals benchmark supported metals [PATH] metals benchmark supported [PARAMS] format [SCHEMA]
